question: The measure of an angle is one half of its supplementary angle. Find its measure.
solution:
**Given:** 

The measure of an angle is one half of its supplementary angle.

**Concept Used:** 

Supplementary Angles = if sum of their measures is 180°

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let one angle be x so another angle will be 180 – x.

⇒ 180 – x = (1)/(2) × x

⇒ 180 = x+(x)/(2)=(3)/(2)x

⇒ x=(180times 2)/(3)

⇒ x = 120° 

⇒ other angle would be, 180 – x = 180 – 120 = 60 °

**Therefore, the measure of the angle would be 60°**
